prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, timeline, and whether you need growth/paid performance, SEO, content, creative/branding, product-led growth, or a full-service partner.

To help you pick the best fit, tell me a few things:
- What are your top goals? (e.g., increase MQLs for B2B SaaS, scale e‑commerce revenue, launch a brand campaign, improve SEO)
- Monthly/annual budget range
- Company stage and size (startup, scaleup, enterprise)
- Industries or competitors you want to match/beat
- Preferred engagement (retainer, project, performance-based)
- Any must-have services (PPC, SEO, content, analytics, creative, CRO)

If you want immediate guidance, here’s a short, practical framework and vetting checklist you can use right away:

How to define “best” for you
- Outcomes: track record of the specific goals you care about (e.g., CAC reduction, revenue growth, pipeline generation)
- Industry experience: case studies in your vertical (B2B SaaS, fintech, healthcare, e‑commerce)
- Team & culture fit: senior involvement, team stability, communication cadence
- Measurement & process: clear KPIs, dashboards, A/B testing and reporting
- Pricing & contract flexibility: trial projects, performance incentives, reasonable minimums
- Tech compatibility: experience with your martech stack (Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, GA4, Shopify, etc.)

Quick vetting checklist/questions to ask prospective agencies
- Show 2–3 case studies with KPIs and before/after results
- Who will be the day-to-day contacts and how much senior time will we get?
- What tools/platforms do you use? Will we own the accounts/data?
- What is your onboarding process and expected 90-day deliverables?
- How do you measure and report ROI? Can you provide sample reports?
- References from clients in our industry or of our size
- Typical pricing model and minimum engagement

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a tailored shortlist of 4–6 SF agencies that match your goals and budget (with pros/cons and estimated pricing)
- Draft an RFP or outreach email you can use
- Create a shortlist and comparison matrix (experience, pricing, key services, contact)

Which would you prefer? Provide the quick details above and I’ll build a targeted list.
